fr.text: Ne poursuis pas Singed : sa Piste empoisonnée (A) te ronge pendant toute la chasse, et pendant ce temps tu perds ta wave et ton temps.
Évite les fights longs pendant la Potion de démence (R) de Singed : la potion lui donne de grosses stats. Engage plutôt quand son ult est en CD.
Surveille la mana de Singed. À sec, Singed ne peut plus pousser ni proxy longtemps : barre-lui la route au lieu de le laisser farmer.
Quand Singed proxy derrière ta tour, ne le chase pas seul : punis-le avec ton jungler. Sinon, farm ta wave et bouge en premier sur la map.
Garde tes distances : sa Projection (E) te lance derrière Singed, vers ses alliés, et te root si tu atterris dans son Attrape-mouche (Z), qui bloque aussi tes dash.

en.text: Don't chase Singed. His Poison Trail (Q) keeps eating your HP the whole way, and meanwhile you're losing your wave and wasting time.
Avoid long fights while Singed's Insanity Potion (R) is active; it gives him huge stats. Pick your fights when his ult is on cooldown.
Track Singed's mana. Once he's dry, he can't keep shoving or proxying for long, so block his path instead of letting him farm.
When Singed proxies behind your tower, don't chase him alone; punish him with your jungler. Otherwise, farm your wave and move first on the map.
Keep your distance. Fling (E) tosses you behind Singed, toward his team, and roots you if you land in Mega Adhesive (W), which also stops your dashes.
